import subprocess, time
for i in (31,32,33,36,40):
    s=open(f'/tmp/r29rev/call{i:02d}.sh').read()
    body=s.split("<<'EOF'\n",1)[1].rsplit('\nEOF',1)[0]
    reps=[("startswith('f26d989f')","startswith('e5dc8ef0')"),
          ("SRC = dict(r27=live, r28=open(_p.__file__).read())","SRC = dict(r28=live, r29=open(_p.__file__).read())"),
          ("assert hashlib.sha256(SRC['r28'].encode()).hexdigest().startswith('e5dc8ef0')","assert hashlib.sha256(SRC['r29'].encode()).hexdigest().startswith('866637df')")]
    for a,b in reps:
        if a in body: body=body.replace(a,b)
    assert "f26d989f" not in body and "r27=live" not in body
    body = body.replace("SRC = dict(r28=live,", "assert hashlib.sha256(open(_p.__file__,'rb').read()).hexdigest().startswith('866637df')\nSRC = dict(r28=live,") if "SRC = dict(r28=live," in body else body
    if "import sys, os, io, hashlib" in body or "hashlib" not in body: pass
    open(f'/tmp/r29rev/g{i}.py','w').write(body)
    argv=[]
    t=time.time()
    r=subprocess.run(['/root/work/sign-product/send-venv/bin/python', f'/tmp/r29rev/g{i}.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=540)
    print('=====',i,round(time.time()-t),'rc',r.returncode); print(r.stdout[-4000:]); print(r.stderr[-1500:])
